text: The original fetch adds the generated GET /me/messages/{message-id}/$value operation and splits raw HTTP responses from JSON decoding. DoGetMessage forwards response.body() directly to its fetch listener; existing JSON operations call send_request_json_response. Empty-body substitution with null belongs to the JSON helper, not MIME content. Accepted source retains this separation while later adding queued transport and a nested generated module path. Generated operation prose is not reliable evidence for its actual request path. No network request or stream test ran.
title: Graph MIME fetching uses the raw response path instead of JSON decoding
